integrity: Proof and explicit finite-check source are supplied; special binary results and the original two-factor matrix equivalence are acknowledged as prior work. No independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: For general large alphabets the exact optimal plane size and multiplicity are expressed in terms of the classical open Zarankiewicz extremal matrix numbers; no closed evaluation of those numbers is asserted. Only three factors and distance bound two are covered. Finite checks support, but do not prove, the infinite theorem. Priority comparisons may miss unindexed work.
title: Two-distance visibility in three-factor Hamming graphs: the sharp Zarankiewicz transition
